_doc: Published meta-analyses reproduced from their own forest-plot rows by the harness pooling engine (harness/positive_control.py). A control is HELD only when its rows are read from bytes this repository holds; otherwise PENDING_SOURCE, never filled from memory.

controls.source: WHO REACT Working Group, JAMA 2020;324(13):1330-1341, PMID 32876694, PMC7489434 -- Figure 2 (28-day all-cause mortality, 7 trials)
controls.method: inverse-variance common effect; Paule-Mandel tau^2 with Hartung-Knapp interval
controls.why_pending: the per-trial rows are in Figure 2 of the full text, which is not held: Europe PMC fullTextXML is not available (not in the open-access subset), NCBI efetch db=pmc returns 'The publisher of this article does not allow downloading of the full text in XML form', the PMC page renders blank here and jamanetwork.com answers with a bot-verification page (not bypassed). The held comparator text (cache/corticosteroids-covid19-mortality/comparator_fulltext.txt) has the summaries but no per-trial rows.
controls.expected_reported_by: external review of the corticosteroids-covid19 topic (27 Sep 2026); consistent with the held text's summary OR 0.66 (0.53-0.82) fixed effect and 0.70 (0.48-1.01) random effects, I2 = 15.6%
